completed: MPI-501 FIXED at all THREE restart-comfy callers, not the two the brief named. comfyController generation gate: drain 5 min then REFUSE with code 'restart_blocked_busy'. navigation dev radial: same guard, 30s ceiling, refuse fast so a human can Stop it or wait. routes/remoteModels.js universal-node install: 10 min then SKIP the restart with a loud error - it is fired non-blocking by remotePodLifecycle and CANNOT retry (on a later call the packs read present, `missing` is empty, and no restart is attempted at all), so skipping degrades to the documented pre-MPI-438 behaviour rather than destroying finished work. Commit 4bda87da.

waitForIdleQueue deliberately does NOT reuse getQueue(): that one folds a failed read into {running:[],pending:[]}, which for a safety gate reads as IDLE and green-lights the exact restart it blocks. Here a failed read is UNKNOWN - a blip keeps waiting, three consecutive misses mean ComfyUI is not answering so nothing is left to protect and the restart IS the repair.

scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs MERGES a scoped run. Fresh rows over prior rows keyed model/op, every row stamped with the `run` that produced it, `runs` listed on the file, counts recomputed off the merge, coverage the UNION (unproven only when NEITHER run touched the family), skippedWeights the intersection. Two guards, BOTH before anything is rented: prior engine.got must equal the pinned node_lock tag (re-checked after the Pod answers, which is what catches --allow-unproven-engine), and the prior file must not predate node_lock.json's last commit. Either mismatch refuses and demands a full matrix.

--retry-failed added: reads the evidence, runs only the ops that are not PASS, implies the merge, exits 0 with nothing rented when everything already passes. The runner's exit code now reflects the MERGED counts - the same question release:check asks of the file it just wrote.
